title: Nakhal Fort

terrainReference.basis: Open ground north of the fort below the approach, used to register the outcrop and masonry relative to surrounding grade.

mapIdentity.scope: The 46-control native compound outline includes three curved bastion extensions, a recessed entrance arm and narrow north-side projection. The northern approach affords a lower terrain datum.

note: The dominant central rock rises 13 metres above the original north-side terrain contact. Walls and towers step down to the east and west. The visible rock pockets and rooftop crest heights are inferred from the photograph.
